requirement.description: Invalid user/group validation in _read_vol_str method causes test_3 and test_4 failures with "list of users is not comma-separated or contains invalid characters" error. The validation logic incorrectly rejects valid comma-separated user lists with spaces.
requirement.contract: Fix the user list validation in _read_vol_str to properly accept comma-separated user lists with spaces, ensuring that user lists like "user1, user2" are correctly processed without throwing validation errors.

requirement.description: Missing implementation of idp_checkin method prevents dynamic volume creation for IdP users/groups in test_3 and test_5. The method needs to properly create user and group volumes when called via idp_checkin.
requirement.contract: Implement the idp_checkin method to dynamically create volumes for IdP users and groups according to the test expectations, including proper volume structure and access control.

requirement.description: Dotfile visibility handling in VFS listings is incorrect in test_dots.py, causing wrong inclusion/exclusion of dotfiles in directory listings.
requirement.contract: Fix the dotfile visibility logic in VFS ls() method to correctly respect dotfile access permissions and dotfile visibility settings for different user types.

requirement.description: Group reference resolution is incomplete in the config parsing flow, preventing proper handling of @group syntax in permissions like test_2.
requirement.contract: Complete the implementation of _process_group_references method to properly resolve @group references to individual users in volume permissions.

requirement.description: Path normalization and dot handling in VFS node creation needs improvement to properly handle volume creation and access control for test_vfs.py.
requirement.contract: Improve the VFS node creation logic to properly handle path normalization and dotfile handling in volume creation and access control.
